instrument: Pocatello City Council decision on appeal, Lex Developments conditional use permit (former Hoku site)
summary: The Hearing Examiner denied the CUP on May 19 2026 (failing public facilities, environmental impact and public health/welfare criteria). The Council upheld the denial 4-1 on July 16 2026. Lex filed a 14-page request for reconsideration about July 29; the Council has 60 days to issue a final written decision.
notes: DERIVED deadline about September 27 2026. Developer has stated it will seek judicial review in the 6th Judicial District. CONFLICT: Baxtel lists the project withdrawn/cancelled while the Post Register shows reconsideration pending. Site 49 acres (BoiseDev) vs about 59 acres (Post Register, Baxtel). Party position: the Shoshone-Bannock Tribes' July 7 2026 statement agrees with the Examiner's denial, citing rates, water and environment and noting the site lies within ceded lands (sbtribes.com).

source.citation: Post Register; BoiseDev; Baxtel; sbtribes.com statement July 7 2026
